title: The AI Trick Most People Don't Know
style: Read this like a funny, energetic friend in a quick social video. Playful on the joke, then clear and upbeat.

segments.title: Make AI interview YOU first
segments.say: Most people ask AI for advice and get a generic answer. Here's the trick: make it interview you first.

segments.title: Add one magic line
bullets: Then get pros, cons and a pick
segments.say: Describe the decision you're stuck on. Then add one magic line: ask me three questions first, before you answer. Now the advice actually fits your situation. You still make the final call.

chat.user: I'm deciding between [hiring a helper] and [a delivery service]. Ask me 3 questions first, then give pros, cons and a recommendation.
chat.ai:
Happy to help! First:
1. How many deliveries a week?
2. What's your monthly budget?
3. Would a helper also cover the floor?

segments.title: Follow for more AI tricks
bullets: Copy the prompt from the description
segments.say: What decision are you stuck on right now? Tell me and I'll write you the prompt. Follow Run It With AI for a new trick every week.
